I cannot say enough good things about this vets office.  All of their vets on staff are smart, compassionate, and very driven to do whats best for your pets. I had a cat with HCM and they gave me YEARS more time than expected because of the amazing care they gave him.  When my other cat cut off part of his paw they took him within MINUTES of his accident and stitched him right up even though he was acting like an absolute psycho. I have a very very nervous xolo, and rather than treating her like a dangerous dog, they treated her like a scared dog.  Gentle,  patient and kind.  I recently adopted a  puppy from a fake rescue and he had 2 seizures right after taking him home. Not only did they see him within minutes of his seizures, they stayed hours late to care for him and told me to report the rescue. He is now happy and doing great. Every single person who works there is kind and down to earth, from front desk and asistants to the vets i just love them so much. Its the only place i trust with my babies.
The best !!!!

My mother had dropped one of our dogs yesterday here to be fixed. She was promised to have our dog Shintaro back around 1:30. When she had arrived, the nurse told her to wait so they can get him ready. She had told me that when she waited, she had been left alone for an hour and while waiting, she said someone else was walking away from the place in someone else’s arms. When she realized, she asked the nurse what was going on when they had realized they had given OUR dog to SOMEONE ELSE. The other lady’s dog was left unclaimed and the nurse was confuse when she had realized she had given someone else’s dog away.

Thank GOD the lady who took our dog came back and he is now safely at home but the carelessness of how this was handled was absurd. What if that lady never returned back and left with our poor boy?

Please do better.
My mother is not one to be confrontational but if I was present with her, I would have said something because how can someone be so careless?

I ended up paying $12 for a cardboard carrier, but it was well worth it to be treated with respect and faces that reflect the service. I loved it here and will be returning to  donate and maybe even volunteer! ❤️❤️❤️

I had a very disappointing experience at this clinic and will not be returning. The staff seemed unequipped to properly handle large working breeds like my dog, a Belgian Malinois. What should have been a simple visit quickly escalated into a stressful situation due to poor communication, excessive restraint, and a lack of compassion.
At one point, my dog was being restrained so tightly around the neck with a slip-style leash that Stop stop it appeared to be affecting his comfort and breathing, even after he had started calming down. Instead of helping de-escalate the situation, the environment became more tense and confrontational. I was also uncomfortable with the way staff spoke to me during the interaction.
I understand safety protocols are important, but professionalism, empathy, and calm handling matter just as much especially with stressed animals. Unfortunately, I did not feel that my dog was treated with the patience or understanding he deserved.
I’ll gladly pay more elsewhere for a clinic that works collaboratively with owners and treats animals with more compassion and care
I was disappointed that they only accept animals.

Quick, kind and efficient service. Staff is willing to go up and beyond service to help all.

CAMP is a wonderful find. I took my diabetic foster cat in to be evaluated yesterday. From Cristal to Dr. Evelyn to all the staff who took care of us, everyone was compassionate and free of judgement. Pricing is extremely competitive. For a community nonprofit clinic, they can’t treat every condition. But they are flexible and transparent, and helped us figure out a realistic treatment plan. For LA people who have trouble getting in at the South LA clinic, San Pedro was a really wonderful alternative to be seen sooner. We were in and out in about two hours for our involved appointment. The clinic is extremely comfortable, but small. We were able to use the bathroom at the cafe across the street. Support CAMP however you can! We are lucky to have them in Southern California.

Got a voucher to neuter my puppy.
Followed all protocol and sent in consent.
Arrived early, waited in line at 7am and talked with other clientele dropping off pets. Most of us nervous to leave our fur-babes.
Along came check-in staff - Angelika M. Got yelled at, not "to talk to the people in line and that the animals shouldn't engage with each other." I can understand and respect that. But she continued on when I said I feel very uncomfortable and may have to leave. She stated she "doesn't want any animal fights in line." My puppy is friendly while other dogs were disruptive in line. But she directed her frustration toward me. I usually don't leave reviews, but this is important to get across, I have no idea how she got a job in customer service ESPECIALLY helping tend to our beloved furbabies. I have no idea how the veterinary inside works. I heard good and not so good reviews, but my experience wasnt ok at the check in line. Wouldn't trust her with my fur-baby. I left and rather than reassuring me that my pet would be okay in their care, she deliberately discouraged me with antagonistic remarks.
I called CampLA immediately about my concerns and left a detailed voicemail. I received a call back from Jasmine who was kind and understanding, willing to reschedule me for another location as well as hold my depoist and voucher. I preferred the location at San Pedro and I'm awaiting a call back from the manager to schedule.
This is a business where you're getting low cost animal care and bad service at the door. I'm sure somewhere along the line there is skilled caring staff. I noted to her that I will make aware this experience for anyone else interested in knowing honest humane reviews of disappointing treatment at a place that claims to care for our animals. As human owners, humane decency and trust is of utmost importance.

I'm blown away by the excellent service we received at the San Pedro Animal Shelter! We took our dog in for neutering and microchipping, and not only was the staff friendly and attentive, but the prices were unbeatable. We were able to purchase 3 months' worth of Simparica heartworm meds for $22 each, which is a huge cost savings compared to our usual vet. The total cost for the procedure, meds, and microchip was $241, which is an amazing deal.

The process was well-organized, and the staff answered all our questions and made us feel comfortable. Our dog recovered quickly and is healing well - we even got him a surgical suit instead of using the cone, which has worked great in keeping him from bothering his stitches and has been more comfortable for us all. Overall, we're extremely satisfied with the care our dog received, and we'd definitely recommend the San Pedro Animal Shelter to anyone looking for affordable and quality veterinary services. Five stars!
